field.name: FLAG_AP_ENABLE_CPU0
field.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when DAP enables AP0 for CPU0 (CM33) debug access. The register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_AP_ENABLE_CPU1
field.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when DAP enables AP1 for CPU1 (CM33) debug access. The register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_AP_ENABLE_DSP
field.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when DAP enables AP3 for DSP (CoolFlux) debug access. The register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: EFUSE_ATTACK_DETECT
field.description: OTPC can output attack_detect signal when it detects attack when load shadow registers. The output will be cleared by reset. ELS_AS_FLAG is reset by PoR, so the status can be recorded.

field.name: FLAG_LVD_CORE_OCCURED
field.description: This flag register is set 1 when VDD_CORE LVD event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_WDT0_RESET_OCCURED
field.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when WatchDog Timer 0 reset is enabled and reset event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by AO domain POR.

field.name: FLAG_CWDT0_RESET_OCCURED
field.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when Code WatchDog Timer 0 reset is enabled and reset event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by AO domain POR.

field.name: FLAG_WDT0_IRQ_OCCURED
field.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when WatchDog Timer 0 IRQ is enabled and IRQ event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_CWDT0_IRQ_OCCURED
field.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when Code WatchDog Timer 0 IRQ is enabled and IRQ event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_QK_ERROR
field.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when QK_ERROR is flagged from QK PUF block. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_ELS_GLITCH_DETECTED
field.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when GDET error is flagged. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_ANA_GLITCH_DETECTED
field.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when ANALOG GDET error is flagged in SYSCON block. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_TAMPER_EVENT_DETECTED
field.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when tamper event is flagged from TDET. This register is cleared 0 by AO domain POR or by PMC reset event, if tamper detection event is cleared by software.

field.name: FLAG_FLASH_ECC_INVALID
field.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when FLASH controller indicates ECC error. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_SEC_VIOL_IRQ_OCURRED
field.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when security violation is indicated from FLASH sub-system or AHB bus matrix.

field.name: FLAG_CPU0_NS_C_ACC_OCCURED
field.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when CPU0 (CM33) makes non-secure code transactions. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_CPU0_NS_D_ACC_OCCURED
field.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when CPU0 (CM33) makes non-secure data transactions. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_LVD_VSYS_OCCURED
field.description: This flag register is set 1 when VDD_SYS LVD event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_LVD_VDDIO_OCCURED
field.description: This flag register is set 1 when VDD LVD event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by PMC reset event.

field.name: FLAG_WDT1_RESET_OCCURED
field.description: This flag bit is set as 1 when WatchDog Timer 1 reset is enabled and reset event is triggered. This register is cleared 0 by AO domain POR.

field.name: FLAG_CWDT1_RESET_OCCURED

enumeratedValue.description: This timer channel is in use.

enumeratedValue.description: Forces no allocation on cache misses (FRCWT must be asserted)

enumeratedValue.description: Push all modified lines in way 0

enumeratedValue.name: pushw1
enumeratedValue.description: Push all modified lines in way 1

enumeratedValue.name: no_effect
enumeratedValue.description: Write: no effect; Read: no cache command active

enumeratedValue.name: init_cmd
enumeratedValue.description: Write: initiates cache command; Read: cache command active

enumeratedValue.name: no_effect
enumeratedValue.description: Write: no effect; Read: no line command active

enumeratedValue.name: init_cmd

enumeratedValue.name: no_effect
enumeratedValue.description: Write: no effect; Read: no line command active

enumeratedValue.name: init_cmd
enumeratedValue.description: Write: initiate line command; Read: line command active

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Do not ignore TE0 or TE1 errors

enumeratedValue.name: BUSY
enumeratedValue.description: SDR read from this target or an IBI is being pushed out

enumeratedValue.name: BUSY
enumeratedValue.description: SDR write data from the controller, but not in ENTDAA mode

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_IN_HDR_DDR
enumeratedValue.description: I3C bus not in HDR-DDR mode

enumeratedValue.name: NONE
enumeratedValue.description: NONE (no event or no pending event)

enumeratedValue.name: NO_REQUEST
enumeratedValue.description: NO_REQUEST (request is not sent yet; either there is no START condition yet, or is waiting for Bus-Available or Bus-Idle (HJ))

enumeratedValue.name: NACKED
enumeratedValue.description: NACKed (not acknowledged, request sent and rejected); I3C tries again

enumeratedValue.name: ACKED
enumeratedValue.description: ACKed (acknowledged; request sent and accepted), so done (unless the time control data is still being sent)

field.name: ACTSTATE
field.description: Activity State from Common Command Codes (CCC)

enumeratedValue.name: ASYNC_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: ASYNC_MODE (Asynchronous standard mode (0 or 1) is enabled)

enumeratedValue.name: BOTHSYNCASYNC
enumeratedValue.description: BOTHSYNCASYNC (both Synchronous and Asynchronous modes are enabled)

enumeratedValue.name: NO_ERROR
enumeratedValue.description: No TE0 or TE1 error occurred

enumeratedValue.name: HALF_WORD
enumeratedValue.description: Halfword (16 bits) (this value ensures that two bytes are available in the FIFO)

enumeratedValue.name: TRIGGRONELESS
enumeratedValue.description: Default (trigger when 1 less than full or less)

enumeratedValue.name: HW_BUT
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware, but the I3C module instance handles ID 48b

enumeratedValue.name: ID_INSTANCE
enumeratedValue.description: ID Instance is a register; used if there is no PARTNO register

enumeratedValue.name: IDRAND

enumeratedValue.description: Assertion of error signal for corresponding channel generates error interrupt request

enumeratedValue.description: Buffered writes on system bus disabled

enumeratedValue.description: Buffered writes on system bus enabled

enumeratedValue.description: Dummy Read strobe that FlexSPI generates, looped back from DQS pad

enumeratedValue.name: val2
enumeratedValue.description: SCLK output clock and looped back from SCLK pad

enumeratedValue.name: val3

field.name: HSEN
field.description: Half Speed Serial Flash Memory Access Enable

field.name: IPGRANTWAIT
field.description: Timeout Wait Cycle for IP Command Grant

field.name: AHBGRANTWAIT
field.description: Timeouts Wait Cycle for AHB command Grant

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: Reset sample clock phase selection to 0

enumeratedValue.name: individual_parallel
enumeratedValue.description: In Individual mode, FLSHA1CRx and FLSHA2CRx, FLSHB1CRx and FLSHB2CRx settings are applied to Flash A1, A2, B1, B2 separately. In Parallel mode, FLSHA1CRx register setting is applied to Flash A1 and B1, FLSHA2CRx register setting is applied to Flash A2 and B2. FLSHB1CRx and FLSHB2CRx register settings are ignored.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: FLSHA1CR0, FLSHA1CR1, and FLSHA1CR2 register settings are applied to Flash A1, A2, B1, B2. FLSHA2CRx, FLSHB1CRx, and FLSHB2CRx settings are ignored.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: Use B_SCLK pad as port B SCLK clock output. Port B flash memory access is available.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: Use B_SCLK pad as port A SCLK inverted clock output (Differential clock to A_SCLK). Port B flash memory access is not available.

enumeratedValue.name: val0
enumeratedValue.description: Dummy read strobe that FlexSPI generates, looped back internally.

enumeratedValue.name: val1
enumeratedValue.description: Dummy read strobe that FlexSPI generates, looped back from DQS pad.

enumeratedValue.name: val2
enumeratedValue.description: SCLK output clock and looped back from SCLK pad

enumeratedValue.name: val3

field.name: SPLIT

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: DBLPWM is not split. PWM_A and PWM_B each have double pulses.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: DBLPWM is split to PWM_A and PWM_B.

enumeratedValue.name: EQUAL_TO
enumeratedValue.description: The VAL* registers and the PWM counter are compared using an "equal to" method. This means that PWM edges are only produced when the counter is equal to one of the VAL* register values. This implies that a PWM_A output that is high at the end of a period maintains this state until a match with VAL3 clears the output in the following period.

enumeratedValue.name: EQUAL_TO_OR_GREATER_THAN
enumeratedValue.description: The VAL* registers and the PWM counter are compared using an "equal to or greater than" method. This means that PWM edges are produced when the counter is equal to or greater than one of the VAL* register values. This implies that a PWM_A output that is high at the end of a period could go low at the start of the next period if the starting counter value is greater than (but not necessarily equal to) the new VAL3 value.

enumeratedValue.description: Disable fractional cycle length for the PWM period.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enable fractional cycle length for the PWM period.

enumeratedValue.name: INDEPENDENT
enumeratedValue.description: PWM_A and PWM_B outputs are independent PWMs.

enumeratedValue.name: NEXT_PWM_RELOAD
enumeratedValue.description: Buffered registers of this submodule are loaded and take effect at the next PWM reload if MCTRL[LDOK] is set.

enumeratedValue.name: MTCTRL_LDOK_SET
enumeratedValue.description: Buffered registers of this submodule are loaded and take effect immediately upon MCTRL[LDOK] being set. In this case, it is not necessary to set CTRL[FULL] or CTRL[HALF].

field.name: SPLIT
field.description: Split the DBLPWM signal to PWM_A and PWM_B

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: DBLPWM is not split. PWM_A and PWM_B each have double pulses.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: DBLPWM is split to PWM_A and PWM_B.

enumeratedValue.name: EQUAL_TO
enumeratedValue.description: The VAL* registers and the PWM counter are compared using an "equal to" method. This means that PWM edges are only produced when the counter is equal to one of the VAL* register values. This implies that a PWM_A output that is high at the end of a period maintains this state until a match with VAL3 clears the output in the following period.

enumeratedValue.name: EQUAL_TO_OR_GREATER_THAN
enumeratedValue.description: The VAL* registers and the PWM counter are compared using an "equal to or greater than" method. This means that PWM edges are produced when the counter is equal to or greater than one of the VAL* register values. This implies that a PWM_A output that is high at the end of a period could go low at the start of the next period if the starting counter value is greater than (but not necessarily equal to) the new VAL3 value.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disable fractional cycle length for the PWM period.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enable fractional cycle length for the PWM period.

enumeratedValue.name: EQUAL_TO
enumeratedValue.description: The VAL* registers and the PWM counter are compared using an "equal to" method. This means that PWM edges are only produced when the counter is equal to one of the VAL* register values. This implies that a PWM_A output that is high at the end of a period maintains this state until a match with VAL3 clears the output in the following period.

enumeratedValue.name: EQUAL_TO_OR_GREATER_THAN
enumeratedValue.description: The VAL* registers and the PWM counter are compared using an "equal to or greater than" method. This means that PWM edges are produced when the counter is equal to or greater than one of the VAL* register values. This implies that a PWM_A output that is high at the end of a period could go low at the start of the next period if the starting counter value is greater than (but not necessarily equal to) the new VAL3 value.

field.name: STRETCH_CNT_PRSC
field.description: Stretch IPBus clock count prescaler for mux0_trig/mux1_trig/out0_trig/out1_trig/pwma_trig/pwmb_trig

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Stretch count is zero, no stretch.

enumeratedValue.name: NORMAL
enumeratedValue.description: Normal mode. PWM outputs disabled by this fault are not enabled until FSTS[FFLAGx] is clear at the start of a half cycle or full cycle depending on the states of FSTS[FHALF] and FSTS[FFULL] without regard to the state of FSTS[FFPINx]. If neither FHALF nor FFULL is set, then the fault condition cannot be cleared. The PWM outputs disabled by this fault input will not be re-enabled until the actual FAULTx input signal de-asserts since the fault input will combinationally disable the PWM outputs (as programmed in DISMAPn).

enumeratedValue.name: SAFE
enumeratedValue.description: Safe mode. PWM outputs disabled by this fault are not enabled until FSTS[FFLAGx] is clear and FSTS[FFPINx] is clear at the start of a half cycle or full cycle depending on the states of FSTS[FHALF] and FSTS[FFULL]. If neither FHLAF nor FFULL is set, then the fault condition cannot be cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: MANUAL
enumeratedValue.description: Manual fault clearing. PWM outputs disabled by this fault are not enabled until FSTS[FFLAGx] is clear at the start of a half cycle or full cycle depending on the states of FSTS[FHALF] and FSTS[FFULL]. If neither FFULL nor FHALF is set, then the fault condition cannot be cleared. This is further controlled by FCTRL[FSAFE].

enumeratedValue.name: AUTOMATIC
enumeratedValue.description: Automatic fault clearing. PWM outputs disabled by this fault are enabled when FSTS[FFPINx] is clear at the start of a half cycle or full cycle depending on the states of FSTS[FHALF] and FSTS[FFULL] without regard to the state of FSTS[FFLAGx]. If neither FFULL nor FHALF is set, then the fault condition cannot be cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: LOGIC_0
enumeratedValue.description: A logic 0 on the fault input indicates a fault condition.

enumeratedValue.name: LOGIC_1
enumeratedValue.description: A logic 1 on the fault input indicates a fault condition.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_FLAG
enumeratedValue.description: No fault on the FAULTx pin.

enumeratedValue.name: PWM_OUTPUTS_NOT_REENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: PWM outputs are not re-enabled at the start of a full cycle

enumeratedValue.name: PWM_OUTPUTS_REENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: PWM outputs are re-enabled at the start of a full cycle

enumeratedValue.name: PWM_OUTPUTS_NOT_REENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: PWM outputs are not re-enabled at the start of a half cycle.

enumeratedValue.name: PWM_OUTPUTS_REENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: PWM outputs are re-enabled at the start of a half cycle (as defined by VAL0).

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Fault input glitch stretching is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Input fault signals are stretched to at least 2 IPBus clock cycles.

field.name: NOCOMB
field.description: No Combinational Path From Fault Input To PWM Output

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: The direct combinational path from the fault inputs to the PWM outputs is disabled and the filtered and latched fault signals are used to disable the PWM outputs.

field.description: Number of the Last Message Buffer

enumeratedValue.description: Format A: One full ID (standard and extended) per ID filter table element.

enumeratedValue.name: two_full_ID
enumeratedValue.description: Format B: Two full standard IDs or two partial 14-bit (standard and extended) IDs per ID filter table element.

enumeratedValue.name: four_partial_ID
enumeratedValue.description: Format C: Four partial 8-bit standard IDs per ID filter table element.

field.name: IRMQ
field.description: Individual RX Masking and Queue Enable

enumeratedValue.name: freeze_mode_no
enumeratedValue.description: Not in Freeze mode, prescaler running.

enumeratedValue.name: id1
enumeratedValue.description: FlexCAN is in Normal mode, Listen-Only mode, or Loopback mode.

enumeratedValue.name: id4
enumeratedValue.description: FlexCAN is in Disable mode, Stop mode, or Freeze mode.

enumeratedValue.name: listen_only_mode_enabled
enumeratedValue.description: FlexCAN module operates in Listen-Only mode.

enumeratedValue.name: highest_buffer_first
enumeratedValue.description: Buffer with highest priority is transmitted first.

enumeratedValue.name: lowest_buffer_first
enumeratedValue.description: Lowest number buffer is transmitted first.

enumeratedValue.name: one_sample
enumeratedValue.description: One sample is used to determine the bit value.

enumeratedValue.name: three_sample
enumeratedValue.description: Three samples are used to determine the value of the received bit: the regular one (sample point) and two preceding samples. A majority rule is used.

field.name: MG
field.description: Global Mask for RX Message Buffers

field.name: TXERRCNT_FAST
field.description: Transmit Error Counter for Fast Bits

field.name: RXERRCNT_FAST
field.description: Receive Error Counter for Fast Bits

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Indicates that a recessive-to-dominant transition was received on the CAN bus.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Indicates setting of any error flag in the Error and Status register.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: FlexCAN module entered Bus Off state.

enumeratedValue.name: RXERRCNT_GTE_96
enumeratedValue.description: RXERRCNT is greater than or equal to 96.

enumeratedValue.name: stuffing_error_yes
enumeratedValue.description: Error occurred since last read of this register.

enumeratedValue.name: form_error_yes
enumeratedValue.description: Error occurred since last read of this register.

enumeratedValue.name: CRC_error_yes
enumeratedValue.description: Error occurred since last read of this register.

enumeratedValue.name: ACK_error_yes
enumeratedValue.description: Error occurred since last read of this register.

enumeratedValue.name: bit0_error_yes
enumeratedValue.description: At least one bit sent as dominant is received as recessive.

enumeratedValue.name: bit1_error_yes
enumeratedValue.description: At least one bit sent as recessive is received as dominant.

enumeratedValue.name: Rx_warning_int_yes
enumeratedValue.description: RX error counter changed from less than 96 to greater than or equal to 96.

enumeratedValue.name: Tx_warning_int_yes
enumeratedValue.description: TX error counter changed from less than 96 to greater than or equal to 96.

enumeratedValue.name: bus_off_done
enumeratedValue.description: FlexCAN module has completed Bus Off process.

enumeratedValue.name: errors_data_phase_yes
enumeratedValue.description: Error flag set in the data phase of CAN FD frames that have BRS = 1.

enumeratedValue.name: stuffing_error_yes
enumeratedValue.description: A stuffing error occurred since last read of this register.

enumeratedValue.name: form_error_yes
enumeratedValue.description: A form error occurred since last read of this register.

field.name: CRCERR_FAST
field.description: Fast Cyclic Redundancy Check Error Flag

enumeratedValue.name: CRC_error_yes
enumeratedValue.description: A CRC error occurred since last read of this register.

enumeratedValue.name: bit0_error_yes
enumeratedValue.description: At least one bit transmitted as dominant is received as recessive.

enumeratedValue.name: bit1_error_yes
enumeratedValue.description: At least one bit transmitted as recessive is received as dominant.

field.name: BUF0I
field.description: Buffer MB0 Interrupt or Clear Legacy FIFO bit

enumeratedValue.name: buffer_Tx_Rx_not_complete
enumeratedValue.description: MB0 has no occurrence of successfully completed transmission or reception.

enumeratedValue.name: buffer_Tx_Rx_complete
enumeratedValue.description: MB0 has successfully completed transmission or reception.

field.name: BUF5I
field.description: Buffer MB5 Interrupt or Frames available in Legacy RX FIFO

enumeratedValue.name: id1
enumeratedValue.description: No occurrence of completed transmission or reception, or no frames available

enumeratedValue.name: id2
enumeratedValue.description: MB5 completed transmission or reception, or frames available

field.name: BUF6I
field.description: Buffer MB6 Interrupt or Legacy RX FIFO Warning

enumeratedValue.name: id1
enumeratedValue.description: No occurrence of MB6 completing transmission or reception, or FIFO not almost full.

enumeratedValue.name: id2
enumeratedValue.description: MB6 completed transmission or reception, or FIFO almost full.

field.name: BUF7I
field.description: Buffer MB7 Interrupt or Legacy RX FIFO Overflow

enumeratedValue.name: id1
enumeratedValue.description: No occurrence of MB7 completing transmission or reception, or no FIFO overflow.

enumeratedValue.name: id2
enumeratedValue.description: MB7 completed transmission or reception, or FIFO overflow.

field.name: EACEN
field.description: Entire Frame Arbitration Field Comparison Enable for RX Message Buffers

enumeratedValue.name: id1
enumeratedValue.description: Matching starts from Legacy RX FIFO or Enhanced RX FIFO and continues on message buffers.

enumeratedValue.name: id3
enumeratedValue.description: Matching starts from message buffers and continues on Legacy RX FIFO or Enhanced RX FIFO.

field.name: RFFN
field.description: Number of Legacy Receive FIFO Filters

field.name: ERRMSK_FAST
field.description: Error Interrupt Mask for Errors Detected in the Data Phase of Fast CAN FD Frames

enumeratedValue.name: inactive_mailbox_no
enumeratedValue.description: Message buffer indicated by ESR2[LPTM] is not inactive.

enumeratedValue.name: inactive_mailbox_yes
enumeratedValue.description: At least one message buffer is inactive.

field.name: FGM
field.description: Legacy RX FIFO Global Mask Bits

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.name: DLC
field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.name: RTR
field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: CODE
field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

field.name: TIME_STAMP

field.name: ESI

field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.name: DLC
field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.name: RTR
field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: CODE
field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: EXT
field.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: STD
field.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: PRIO
field.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.name: DLC
field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: CODE
field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

enumeratedValue.name: PRE_ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: ADC analog circuits are pre-enabled and ready to execute conversions without startup delays, at the cost of higher DC current consumption. A single power-up delay (CFG[PUDLY]) is executed immediately once PWREN is set. No detected triggers begin ADC operation until the power-up delay time has passed. After this initial delay expires, the analog circuits remain pre-enabled, and no additional delays are executed.

enumeratedValue.name: LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes to this register and to the Memory and Peripheral RULE registers are not allowed

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes to this register and to the Memory and Peripheral RULE registers are allowed

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enables secure checking. Violation can be detected when the security level of a transaction does not meet the security rule of the slave or memory to be accessed.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disables secure checking. Even if the security level of a transaction does not conform to the security rule of the slave or memory, it will not be detected as a violation.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enables the privilege checking of secure mode access.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disables the privilege checking of secure mode access.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enables the privilege checking of non-secure mode access.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disables the privilege checking of non-secure mode access.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_ABORT
enumeratedValue.description: The violation detected by the secure checker will not cause an abort, but a secure_violation_irq (interrupt request) will still be asserted and serviced by ISR.

enumeratedValue.name: ABORT
enumeratedValue.description: The violation detected by the secure checker will cause an abort.

enumeratedValue.name: AHBTM
enumeratedValue.description: Master can access memories and peripherals at the same level or below that level.

enumeratedValue.name: AHBSM1
enumeratedValue.description: Master can access memories and peripherals at same level only

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: IDAU is disabled, which means that all memories are attributed as non-secure memory.

enumeratedValue.name: LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes to this register and to the Memory and Peripheral RULE registers are not allowed

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_LOCKED
enumeratedValue.description: Writes to this register and to the Memory and Peripheral RULE registers are allowed

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enables secure checking. Violation can be detected when the security level of a transaction does not meet the security rule of the slave or memory to be accessed.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disables secure checking. Even if the security level of a transaction does not conform to the security rule of the slave or memory, it will not be detected as a violation.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enables privilege checking of secure mode access.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disables privilege checking of secure mode access.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enables privilege checking of non-secure mode access.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disables privilege checking of non-secure mode access is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_ABORT
enumeratedValue.description: The violation detected by the secure checker will not cause an abort, but a secure_violation_irq (interrupt request) will still be asserted and serviced by ISR.

enumeratedValue.name: ABORT
enumeratedValue.description: The violation detected by the secure checker will cause an abort.

enumeratedValue.name: AHBTM
enumeratedValue.description: Master strict mode is on and can access memories and peripherals at the same level or below that level

enumeratedValue.name: AHBSM1
enumeratedValue.description: Master strict mode is disabled and can access memories and peripherals at same level only

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: IDAU is disabled, which means that all memories are attributed as non-secure memory.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_PENDING
enumeratedValue.description: Write: No effect; Read: Interrupt 32n+m is not pending

enumeratedValue.name: PENDING

field.name: INTID
field.description: Interrupt ID of the interrupt to trigger, in the range 0-479.

register.name: AIRCR
register.description: Application Interrupt and Reset Control Register

field.name: VECTCLRACTIVE
field.description: Reserved for Debug use. This bit reads as 0. When writing to the register you must write 0 to this bit, otherwise behavior is UNPREDICTABLE. This bit is not banked between Security states.

field.name: SYSRESETREQ
field.description: System reset request. This bit allows software or a debugger to request a system reset. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW if SYSRESETREQS is 0. When SYSRESETREQS is set to 1, from Non-secure state this bit acts as RAZ/WI.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_REQUEST
enumeratedValue.description: Do not request a system reset.

field.name: SYSRESETREQS
field.description: System reset request, Secure state only. The value of this bit defines whether the SYSRESETREQ bit is functional for Non-secure use. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW from Secure State and RAZ/WI from Non-secure state.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURE_AND_NON_SECURE
enumeratedValue.description: SYSRESETREQ functionality is available to both Security states.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURE_ONLY
enumeratedValue.description: SYSRESETREQ functionality is only available to Secure state.

field.name: PRIGROUP
field.description: Interrupt priority grouping field. This field determines the split of group priority from subpriority. This bit is banked between Security states

field.name: BFHFNMINS
field.description: BusFault, HardFault, and NMI Non-secure enable. The value of this bit defines whether BusFault and NMI exceptions are Non-secure, and whether exceptions target the Non-secure HardFault exception. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW from Secure-state and RO from Non-secure state.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURE
enumeratedValue.description: BusFault, HardFault, and NMI are Secure.

enumeratedValue.name: NON_SECURE
enumeratedValue.description: BusFault and NMI are Non-secure and exceptions can target Non-secure HardFault.

field.name: PRIS
field.description: Prioritize Secure exceptions. The value of this bit defines whether Secure exception priority boosting is enabled. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW from Secure state and RAZ/WI from Non-secure state.

enumeratedValue.name: SAME_PRIORITY
enumeratedValue.description: Priority ranges of Secure and Non-secure exceptions are identical

field.name: ENDIANNESS
field.description: Data endianness bit. This bit is not banked between Security states.

field.name: VECTKEY
field.description: Register key: Reads as 0xFA05. On writes, write 0x5FA to VECTKEY, otherwise the write is ignored. This Field is not banked between Security states.

register.name: SCR
register.description: The SCR controls features of entry to and exit from low-power state.

field.name: SLEEPONEXIT
field.description: Indicates sleep-on-exit when returning from Handler mode to Thread mode. Setting this bit to 1 enables an interrupt driven application to avoid returning to an empty main application. This bit is banked between Security states.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_SLEEP
enumeratedValue.description: Do not sleep when returning to Thread mode.

enumeratedValue.name: SLEEP
enumeratedValue.description: Enter sleep, or deep sleep, on return from an ISR

field.name: SLEEPDEEP
field.description: Controls whether the processor uses sleep or deep sleep as its low-power mode. This bit is not banked between Security states.

field.name: SLEEPDEEPS
field.description: Controls whether the SLEEPDEEP bit is only accessible from the Secure state. This bit in only accessible from the Secure state, and behaves as RAZ/WI when accessed from the Nonsecure state. This bit is not banked between Security states.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURE_AND_NON_SECURE
enumeratedValue.description: The SLEEPDEEP bit is accessible from both Security states.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURE_ONLY
enumeratedValue.description: The SLEEPDEEP bit behaves as RAZ/WI when accessed from the Non-secure state.

field.name: SEVONPEND
field.description: Send Event on Pending bit. When an event or interrupt enters pending state, the event signal wakes up the processor from WFE. If the processor is not waiting for an event, the event is registered and affects the next WFE. The processor also wakes up on execution of an SEV instruction or an external event. This bit is banked between Security states.

enumeratedValue.name: EXCLUDE_DISABLED_INTERRUPTS
enumeratedValue.description: Only enabled interrupts or events can wakeup the processor, disabled interrupts are excluded.

enumeratedValue.name: INCLUDE_DISABLED_INTERRUPTS
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled events and all interrupts, including disabled interrupts, can wakeup the processor

register.name: SHCSR
register.description: System Handler Control and State Register

enumeratedValue.description: Debug monitor exception is not active.

register.name: TYPE
register.description: The MPU Type Register indicates how many regions the MPU support. Software can use it to determine if the processor implements an MPU.

field.name: SEPARATE
field.description: Indicates support for separate instruction and data address maps. RAZ. Armv8-M only supports a unified MPU

field.name: DREGION
field.description: Number of regions supported by the MPU. If this field reads-as-zero the processor does not implement an MPU.

field.name: HFNMIENA
field.description: Enables the operation of MPU during HardFault and NMI handlers

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: MPU is disabled during HardFault and NMI handlers.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: The MPU is enabled during HardFault and NMI handlers.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Disables the default memory map. Any instruction or data access that does not access a defined region faults.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLE
enumeratedValue.description: Enables the default memory map as a background region for privileged accesses.

field.name: REGION
field.description: Indicates the memory region accessed by MPU_RBAR and MPU_RASR.

field.name: XN
field.description: The XN bit is an Execute Never bit, that indicates whether the processor can execute instructions from the region.

enumeratedValue.name: EXECUTE
enumeratedValue.description: Execution is only permitted if read permitted.

field.name: AP
field.description: The AP[2:0] bits indicate the access and privilege properties of the region.

field.name: SH
field.description: For Normal memory regions, the S bit indicates whether the region is shareable. For Strongly-ordered and Device memory, the S bit is ignored.

field.name: BASE
field.description: Contains bits[31:5] of the lower inclusive limit of the selected MPU memory region. This value is zero extended to provide the base address to be checked against.

field.name: ATTRINDX
field.description: Attribute index. Associates a set of attributes in the MPU_MAIR0 and MPU_MAIR1 fields.

field.name: LIMIT
field.description: Limit address. Contains bits[31:5] of the upper inclusive limit of the selected MPU memory region. This value is postfixed with 0x1F to provide the limit address to be checked against.

field.name: XN
field.description: The XN bit is an Execute Never bit, that indicates whether the processor can execute instructions from the region.

field.name: ENABLE
field.description: Enable. Enables the SAU. This bit is RAZ/WI when the Security Extension is implemented without an SAU region.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURED_MEMORY
enumeratedValue.description: Memory is marked as Secure and is not Non-secure callable.

field.name: SREGION
field.description: SAU regions. The number of implemented SAU regions.

register.name: RNR
register.description: Security Attribution Unit Region Number Register

register.name: RBAR
register.description: Security Attribution Unit Region Base Address Register

field.name: BADDR
field.description: Base address. Holds bits[31:5] of the base address for the selected SAU region. Bits[4:0] of the base address are defined as 0x00.

register.name: RLAR
register.description: Security Attribution Unit Region Limit Address Register

field.name: NSC
field.description: Non-secure callable. Controls whether Non-secure state is permitted to execute an SG instruction from this region.

field.name: LADDR
field.description: Limit address. Holds bits[31:5] of the limit address for the selected SAU region. Bits[4:0] of the limit address are defined as 0x1F.

field.name: ADDRESS
field.description: When the SFARVALID bit of the SFSR is set to 1, this field holds the address of an access that caused an SAU violation.
